sql: SELECT country, COUNT(customerNumber) FROM customers GROUP BY country

SELECT p.productName FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode WHERE p.productLine = 'Classic Cars' AND p.productScale = '1:18' GROUP BY p.productName ORDER BY SUM(od.quantityOrdered) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(customerNumber) FROM customers WHERE creditLimit <= 100000 AND customerNumber IN (SELECT customerNumber FROM payments WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', paymentDate) = '2004')), c.customerName FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber WHERE c.creditLimit <= 100000 AND STRFTIME('%Y', p.paymentDate) = '2004' GROUP BY c.customerNumber, c.customerName ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.customerName, c.contactFirstName, c.contactLastName, SUM(p.amount) FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber WHERE o.city = 'Tokyo' AND e.reportsTo = 1056 GROUP BY c.customerNumber, c.customerName, c.contactFirstName, c.contactLastName ORDER BY MAX(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT od.orderNumber) FROM orderdetails od JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber WHERE od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach > 4000 AND o.status = 'Cancelled'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT od.orderNumber) FROM orderdetails od JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', o.orderDate) = '2003' AND od.quantityOrdered < 30
SELECT COUNT(od.productCode) FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode WHERE p.MSRP - p.buyPrice > 100
SELECT DISTINCT c.customerName FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE p.amount > 50000
SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE c.country = 'USA'
SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE c.creditLimit = 0 AND STRFTIME('%Y', p.paymentDate) = '2003'

SELECT COUNT(c.country) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE o.status = 'Cancelled' AND c.country = 'France' GROUP BY c.customerNumber HAVING COUNT(o.status) = 2
SELECT COUNT(e.employeeNumber), e.email FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode WHERE e.jobTitle LIKE '%Sales Manager%' AND o.city = 'Sydney'
SELECT COUNT(customerNumber) FROM customers WHERE country = 'Australia' AND creditLimit < 220000
SELECT customerNumber FROM payments ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT e.email, e.employeeNumber FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode WHERE o.country = 'USA' AND o.state = 'CA'
SELECT MAX(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) - AVG(od.priceEach) FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode WHERE p.productLine = 'Planes'

SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, s.firstName, s.lastName FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber JOIN employees s ON e.reportsTo = s.employeeNumber ORDER BY p.amount DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT pr.productName, od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach FROM offices o JOIN employees e ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode JOIN customers c ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber JOIN orders ord ON ord.customerNumber = c.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON od.orderNumber = ord.orderNumber JOIN products pr ON pr.productCode = od.productCode WHERE o.city = 'Boston' ORDER BY od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(od.priceEach - p.buyPrice) FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode JOIN orders o ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN customers c ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber WHERE c.country = 'USA' AND o.orderDate BETWEEN '2003-01-06' AND '2005-05-09'
